title: functional alt 140 decorative empty
rule: Functional alt ≈140 characters; decorative `alt=""`; long description if more. Describe as if on the phone; don’t write “image of…”. If equivalent explanation already sits next to the figure, skip the long desc. Transcripts for pre-recorded audio/video (dialogue, on-screen text, important sound/action).
pass_when: Functional images have concise alt (about 140 characters, not “image of”); decorative `alt=""`; longer meaning has a long desc unless equivalent text is already beside the figure; pre-recorded AV has a transcript.
fail_when: Missing alt; “image of…” filler; decorative images with long alt; no transcript for pre-recorded AV that needs one.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: WCAG SC numbers as this row.
